vocab.definition: a substance made of only one type of atom.
two or more elements chemically bonded together.
substances together but not chemically bonded.
the smallest particle of an element.

misconceptions.wrong: A compound is just a mixture of elements.
misconceptions.right: A compound is chemically bonded; a mixture is not.

misconceptions.wrong: Compounds keep the properties of their elements.
misconceptions.right: A compound has new, different properties.

misconceptions.wrong: All substances are made of molecules.
misconceptions.right: Many are made of atoms or ions, not molecules.

infoPanels.title: ELEMENT · COMPOUND · MIXTURE
infoPanels.secondaryContent: A compound can only be split by a chemical reaction; a mixture can be separated physically.

questions.text: State what is meant by a compound. [1 mark]
Classify each as element, compound or mixture: O₂, H₂O, air. [3 marks]
State the number of atoms of each element in CaCO₃. [1 mark]
Explain one difference between a compound and a mixture. [2 marks]
Complete the sentence using the word bank. [2 marks]
questions.secondaryText: An element contains ______ type of atom. The elements in a compound are joined ______.

questions.text: Iron and sulfur are heated together. Explain why the product is a compound, not a mixture. [2 marks]

footer.thinkPrompt: Why can a mixture be separated without a chemical reaction?
